# 11. Reports are exported as CSV only

Date: 2026-09-05

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-05; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「CSV only; I will not maintain a second export format.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-05

**Options considered:**
- the export feature produces csv only (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

The export feature produces CSV only. No XLSX, PDF or other format is added until this record is superseded.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 10. Exports are generated in a background job

Date: 2026-09-04

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-04; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Exports can be slow.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-04

**Options considered:**
- an export runs as a background job and the user is notified when it is ready (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

An export runs as a background job and the user is notified when it is ready.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 12. Export download links expire after one hour

Date: 2026-09-06

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-06; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Links should not live forever.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-06

**Options considered:**
- a download link for an export stops working after one hour (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

A download link for an export stops working after one hour.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 7. Customer data stays in the EU

Date: 2026-09-12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-09-12; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Customer lists live in EU regions only, for every product I run.」 — Mira Example, 2026-09-12

**Options considered:**
- every product stores and processes customer data in eu regions only (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** data-region

Every product stores and processes customer data in EU regions only. A hosted service is configured with an EU region before it is used.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
# 23. Reports go out daily at 07:00

Date: 2026-10-14

## Status

Accepted

## Context

The decision came up on 2026-10-14; the people involved needed one rule to point at.

## Decision

**Words:** 「Seven suits the shops better than six.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-14

**Options considered:**
- the report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time (chosen)
- leave it undecided — rejected: the question keeps coming back

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

**Decision key:** report-cadence

The report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time. This replaces the 06:00 time of ADR 0014; the daily cadence stays.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it.
